description:
Streamline your systems management

Scan, collect, and organize your on-prem Windows machines so deployments go exactly where you need them to with PDQ Inventory.
New Features
- Added support for LDAPS (LDAP over SSL/TLS) for secure Active Directory connections
- Inventory: Added System Summary datapoints (Secure Boot, TPM, BIOS mode/date, baseboard, virtualization, OS paths/locale) and an MDM Enrollments page to Computer details and reports

Improvements
- Added screen reader announcements for scan and deployment status, including when a scan or deployment finishes, without requiring focus changes
- Deploy: Redesigned the Deployments view with a server-paged Finished history and a fixed Active deployments view, improving performance and memory usage.

Bug Fixes
- Deploy: Improved service reliability by automatically recovering deployments orphaned or stuck in Queued/Running without requiring a service restart
